title: Baatu àll buy tàkk
intro: Waxñu nit ku am solo ki tukki bi tàmbali ci daje bu yéeme, te ëlëgam dafa boole muccal askan wuñ noot. Nit kii dañu ko tànn ngir liggéey bu am solo, di jànkoonte ak jafe-jafe yu metti ndax ndimbalu Yàlla.
clues: Dama judd ci jamonoy noot gu metti, di ray xale yu ndaw yi ci sama askan.
Bi may ndaw, samay waajur dañu ma dugal ci dex gi, waaye ci këru ki daan sonal sama askan, ma yar ko.
Benn bis dama daw ci benn dëkk ginaaw bima faatee kenn ci ay xëccoo te duma ko bëgg.
Ma jot mesaas bu jóge ci Yàlla, ak benn yatt bu yéeme ci barab bu sell, foofu lañu ma digal ma jàkkarloo ak benn njiit bu am doole.
Sama rak lañu fal mu jàppale ma ci sama misioŋ, ndax dañu jàpp ni daa am jafe-jafe ci sama kàddu.
Ma yóbbaale sama askan jàll géej gu xaajaloo, ngir rëcci ci topp larme buy jaay doole.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى فَٱضْرِبْ لَهُمْ طَرِيقًۭا فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ يَبَسًۭا لَّا تَخَـٰفُ دَرَكًۭا وَلَا تَخْشَىٰ
verse: And We had inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants and strike for them a dry path through the sea; you will not fear being overtaken [by Pharaoh] nor be afraid [of drowning]." (20:77)
